messages:
maya: Doing an a11y sweep of the bulk vectors preview. Noting some UX copy and focus problems around the row menu and the export flow. Filing them here so design + eng can align.

cheng: Can you list the exact repro steps/screens?

maya: Repro: open Batch > Preview tab > tab into rows > expand kebab menu on a row. Observed issues: (1) menu items read as 'Download' / 'Copy id' without object context for SRs; (2) top export button label 'Download vectors' doesn't indicate formats; (3) keyboard focus order jumps from checkbox to kebab, skipping row content which is confusing for screen readers.

liam: For menu verbosity let's change to full action labels: 'Download vector as CSV', 'Copy vector ID to clipboard', 'Delete vector (irreversible)'. For top CTA use 'Export vectors (CSV, JSONL)'.

alex: We'll also need a polite aria-live region that announces progress: 'Export started: 8 items', 'Export finished: 8 rows — download link available'. SR users shouldn't get unexpected download popups.

sam: Product question: default export format? modal vs inline delete? My vote: modal confirm for deletes.

maya: Default = CSV. Export modal should have radio for CSV/JSONL with CSV pre-selected. Delete needs a modal with clear destructive copy and keyboard-confirm (e.g., type DELETE or confirm button). Also implement roving tabindex for the kebab menu so arrow keys work and Esc closes.

a11y-bot: a11y-scan: batch-preview v1.0 -> issues found: insufficient menu aria-labels; missing live-region for export; focus order regression. Auto-filed INF-4821.

cheng: I'll draft a PR to update DOM attributes, aria-labels, and add aria-describedby for export helper text. Will include code snippets for roving tabindex.

liam: Acceptance criteria proposal:
- AC1: Main CTA is exactly 'Export vectors (CSV, JSONL)'.
- AC2: Every row action includes the object in the aria-label (e.g., 'Copy vector ID to clipboard').
- AC3: Export flow posts start/complete messages to an aria-live polite region; completion announces a link for SRs.
- AC4: Keyboard tab order: row checkbox -> row content -> kebab button; inside menu arrow navigation works, Enter triggers, Esc closes and focus returns.
- AC5: Delete opens a modal with destructive warning and keyboard-confirmable action.

alex: I'll add axe + cypress tests to cover these. Also add an E2E test that focuses truncated titles and ensures full text exposed on focus.

maya: Small copy suggestions for the export modal: title 'Export vectors', primary button 'Export (CSV)', secondary 'Export (JSONL)'. Helper text: 'Includes vector_id and embedding values (values truncated to 8 decimal places).'. Add aria-describedby to associate helper text with controls.

cheng: Good, I'll add that helper node and point aria-describedby at the format radios.

liam: One more accessibility nit: truncated row titles should reveal full content on keyboard focus (not only hover). Add an SR-visible tooltip that appears on focus and a visually-hidden element with the full title for screen readers.

maya: That should also reduce Support tickets where keyboard users couldn't see full names.

a11y-bot: re-run queued after PR merge; will post results back to this thread.
